scenario: As LCYC.3.2.2_emit_in_call_response_closes_cycle, with the `emit B` in the call's `timeout` body rather than its `on` body: `ra` matches an `A` and emits a `B` when the call times out, and `rb` matches the `B` and emits an `A`. One SCC, `A` emitted and matched inside it (LCYC.3.1.1), refused with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE. PATH PINNED: `dsc.cycle.continuation_actions`'s `timeout` arm; the `on` arm has its own vector, so dropping either arm turns exactly one of the two green-to-compiling.
rules_ds:
schema GoReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String

service s.go:
    kwarg n: Int
    response GoReply

schema A scope explicit:
    v: Int

schema B scope explicit:
    v: Int

rule ra:
    A a
->
    call s.go n: a.v cooldown: 30_s
        timeout 5_s:
            emit B v: a.v

rule rb:
    B b
->
    emit A v: b.v
